artworks.label: Walnut portafilter
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for espresso-hour. An elegant unbranded espresso portafilter resting at a graceful diagonal, warm copper and brass basket filled with glossy dark roasted coffee beans, sculpted dark walnut handle, one tiny curl of coffee-cream steam rising above. Premium realistic artisan still-life photography, rich espresso-brown, warm copper and ivory highlights, tactile walnut grain, soft dramatic cafe light. No grinder, moka pot, cup, crescent or coffee plant; no gauge or dial. Whole subject centered, simple readable silhouette, generous18percent transparent margins. Truly transparent empty background with alpha; no opaque tile, floor, rectangular frame or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numbers, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendar, UI, logo or watermark. Never copy/crop/recolour an existing piece.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
